title: Hazel | Embroidered Everyday Dress
bodyHtml:
For the woman who knows exactly what she wants—to feel beautiful, comfortable and utterly herself. This everyday dress delivers that effortless, feminine edge that turns heads without trying. Slip it on and you're ready to embrace your day with lightness and genuine style.

Why you'll love it

  • Generously cut and fluid through the body—breathes beautifully, moves with you, and never clings in the wrong places
  • Skims your curves with such grace you'll forget you're wearing it, yet flatters and holds everything exactly where it should
  • Lightweight and airy fabric stays soft against your skin all day, from breakfast to evening drinks
  • That subtle embroidered detail lifts the whole look—polished without being precious
  • Brilliantly versatile: works for a farmers market run, a stroll along the coast, a family lunch, coffee with friends or something special
  • Sits beautifully whether you're sitting, standing or moving about—no tugging, no adjusting
  • The kind of dress you reach for again and again because it just makes you feel good

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
